subtopics.name: Reading comprehension
objectives: Identify main ideas and supporting details
Infer meaning and make deductions
Understand vocabulary in context

subtopics.name: Cloze passage
objectives: Apply contextual clues to fill gaps in passages
Choose the correct word or phrase for each gap

subtopics.name: Synonyms
objectives: Identify words with similar meanings
Use context to select the correct synonym

subtopics.name: Antonyms
objectives: Identify opposites of underlined words
Distinguish antonyms from unrelated words

subtopics.name: Idioms and expressions
objectives: Understand meaning of common English idioms
Use idiomatic expressions correctly in context

subtopics.name: Prepositions
objectives: Use prepositions of time, place and direction correctly
Apply prepositional verb collocations
Choose the correct preposition in sentences

subtopics.name: Sentence completion
objectives: Apply subject-verb concord rules
Use correct tense forms in sentence completion
Complete sentences with correct grammatical structures

subtopics.name: Vowel sounds
objectives: Identify words with the same vowel sounds
Distinguish between similar vowel sounds

subtopics.name: Consonant sounds
objectives: Identify words with the same consonant sounds
Recognize consonant clusters and symbols

subtopics.name: Word stress
objectives: Identify emphatic stress in sentences
Apply stress rules to nouns and verbs
Identify stress shifts based on sentence meaning

subtopics.name: Rhymes
objectives: Identify words that rhyme regardless of spelling
Distinguish rhyme from alliteration

subtopics.name: The Life Changer - Plot and themes
objectives: Outline the main events of The Life Changer
Identify major themes in the novel

subtopics.name: The Life Changer - Characters
objectives: Identify main characters and their roles
Analyze character relationships and development

subtopics.name: The Life Changer - Setting and context
objectives: Describe the setting of the novel
Relate setting to the themes and events
